Brand Introduction

Minava is a premium fashion brand specializing in high-quality women's shoes and clothing. Our mission is to empower women by offering them stylish, comfortable, and exclusive designs. Minava stands out with its unique, fashionable styles that are unavailable anywhere else, making our brand the go-to destination for trendsetters and fashion enthusiasts.

Product Description

Our product line includes:

  • Shoes: A curated collection of elegant heels, trendy sneakers, and comfortable flats, crafted from premium materials.
  • Clothing: Stylish and versatile pieces ranging from chic dresses to casual yet fashionable tops and bottoms.
    Minava’s designs reflect a perfect balance of sophistication and functionality, catering to women who value quality and style in every aspect of their wardrobe.

USP (Unique Selling Point)

  1. Exclusive Styles: Minava offers unique designs that are exclusive to our store.
  2. High Quality: We prioritize premium materials and craftsmanship, ensuring durability and comfort.
  3. Fashion-Forward: Minava keeps up with the latest trends while offering timeless elegance.
  4. Customer-Centric: Exceptional service with personalized shopping experiences, including tailored recommendations.

Payment Terms

For the affiliate program:

  • Commission: Earn up to 10% on every successful sale through your referral link.
  • Payment Schedule: Payments will be processed on a monthly basis, with a minimum payout threshold of [X amount].
  • Methods: Commissions are paid via [PayPal, Bank Transfer, etc.].

For customers:

  • We accept major payment methods including credit cards, PayPal, and local payment options.
  • Secure and hassle-free payment processing.

Other Information

  • Marketing Support: Affiliates will have access to high-quality promotional materials, including banners, product images, and suggested copy for posts.
  • Tracking Tools: A dedicated dashboard allows affiliates to track clicks, sales, and earnings in real-time.
  • Returns and Exchanges: We offer a customer-friendly return and exchange policy to ensure satisfaction.
  • Shipping: Minava provides fast and reliable shipping options worldwide.

Terms and Conditions For Minava Affiliate Program

1. Acceptance of Terms
By signing up and participating in the Minava Affiliate Program, you agree to comply with these Terms and Conditions, Minava reserves the right to update or modify these Terms at any time, and you will be notified of such changes.

2. Affiliate Eligibility
Affiliates must be at least 18 years old and operate a legitimate online presence, including websites, blogs, or social media accounts, to participate in the Program. Minava reserves the right to accept or reject any affiliate application at its discretion.

3. Affiliate Links and Promotion
Affiliates will receive unique referral links to track sales made through their promotions. Affiliates are permitted to promote Minava’s products through websites, blogs, social media, email marketing, and other lawful marketing channels. Any promotional activity must adhere to applicable laws and regulations.

4. Commission Structure
Affiliates will earn a commission for every sale generated through their referral links. The commission amount is a percentage of the sale value, as specified in the affiliate account details. Commission rates and payment terms may change at Minava's discretion, and affiliates will be notified of such changes.

5. Cookie Duration
The Program uses a 30-day cookie tracking system. If a customer clicks on your affiliate link, you will receive credit for any qualifying purchases made within 30 days, as long as the purchase is completed during this period.

6. Payment Terms
Commissions are paid on a monthly basis, provided the affiliate meets the minimum payout threshold, as specified in the affiliate account. Payments will be made via the selected payment method e.g., PayPal, bank transfer etc. Minava is not responsible for any fees associated with the payment method.

7. Prohibited Practices
Affiliates must not engage in any fraudulent, deceptive, or unethical marketing practices. This includes, but is not limited to, spamming, misrepresenting the brand, or bidding on Minava’s trademarked keywords in paid advertising. Any violation of these terms may result in immediate termination from the Program and forfeiture of commissions.

8. Intellectual Property
Affiliates may use Minava’s logos, banners, and other marketing materials provided by the Program for promotional purposes. These materials remain the intellectual property of Minava and must be used in accordance with the Program guidelines. Unauthorized use of Minava’s intellectual property is prohibited.

9. Termination and Suspension
Minava reserves the right to terminate or suspend any affiliate account at any time, with or without cause. Upon termination, affiliates must immediately cease using Minava’s marketing materials, and any outstanding commissions will be paid according to the payment terms.

10. Limitation of Liability
Minava is not liable for any indirect, special, or consequential damages arising from participation in the Affiliate Program, including lost revenue or profits. The Program is provided "as it is," and Minava makes no representations or warranties regarding the Program’s functionality.

11. Governing Law
These Terms will be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Your Country/Region. Any disputes arising out of or in connection with these Terms will be resolved in the appropriate Law Of Your Country/Region.

12. Contact Information
If you have any questions or need support regarding the Affiliate Program, please contact us at:
